briefdescription.para: Modify all accessTypes. When determining accessType in recursivelyMakeAccessRecord, sometimes we don't know the correct accessType when we make the AccessSetRecord, so we have to modify it later. But you can't modify set items in place, so I had to make this function to handle this case. It just makes a new set to replace the old one.
